newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY OVERNIGHT RATES CLOSE LOWER AT 22 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY OVERNIGHT RATES CLOSE LOWER AT 22 PERCENT.

text.p: Hungarian overnight interest rates closed at 22 percent, easing 0.5 percentage points from Friday's close and traders said would remain in this range.
"Overnight rates would probably move between 22 to 22.5 percent in the next days," said Attila Behan of ING Bank.
Traders see no reason for the rates to move away considerably from the central bank's one-week reverse repo rate, widely held as a benchmark, currently standing at 22.5 percent.
